name: scripts
description: Fills `apps/greenpassport/{tasks,shopItems,mapPoints,events,ecoTips,surveys}` in Firestore with sample content, matching the exact field names the app's repositories expect (see `core.database.Firestore*Repository`). These are the collections that were empty placeholders — Tasks (10), Shop rewards (6), Map points (5), Calendar events (4), Eco tips (7, one marked as tip of the day), one active survey.
